dialogues.speaker: A Piece of Paper
dialogues.text: "Didn't they say that some Helm of Warding thing was left here by the Millelith? We've been here all day, and there's nothing to show for it!"

dialogues.speaker: A Piece of Paper
dialogues.text: ..."Aren't these just the hats that the miners use? What Helm of Warding? You sure the intel you got was accurate?"

dialogues.speaker: A Piece of Paper
dialogues.text: (The name of the writer, "Erge," has been roughly canceled and written again twice over. It seems that this person isn't too enamored of their own penmanship...)
